title: 2023-2024 Retail Sales Performance Report
executive_summary: This report presents the verified findings from the analysis of retail sales data for the years 2023 and 2024. Key metrics include overall revenue, regional differences, quarterly trends, year-over-year growth, high-discount electronics orders, and customer concentration. The analysis reveals a positive year-over-year growth, significant regional revenue variations, and a notable concentration of revenue among top customers.

key_findings.statement: The total revenue for 2023-2024 was $445,325.09 with 520 orders, resulting in an average order value of $856.39.
Regional revenue was highest in the East ($130,516.69) and lowest in the South ($90,534.49).
In 2024, revenue increased each quarter, with Q3 showing the highest revenue ($71,674.99).
Year-over-year revenue growth from 2023 to 2024 was 10.08%.
There were 22 high-discount electronics orders generating $50,035.33 in revenue.
The distribution of order revenue shows a mean of $856.39, a median of $313.28, and a standard deviation of $1,295.74.
The top customer contributed $27,793.13, representing 6.24% of the total revenue.

limitations: The analysis is based on the cleaned data, which may have inherent limitations or biases.
The year-over-year comparison does not account for seasonal variations or external market factors.
The top customer revenue share may not fully represent customer concentration due to the dynamic nature of customer behavior.
conclusion: The analysis of retail sales data for 2023-2024 indicates a positive revenue trend with significant regional and quarterly variations. The concentration of revenue among top customers highlights the importance of customer retention strategies. Future analyses should consider seasonal adjustments and deeper customer segmentation for more nuanced insights.
